visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable views, including the 1024×640 summary. The adjoining low stone ranges retain separate metal hip roofs, an eight-sided main stone pyramid and smaller six-sided tomb cone, two low roof lanterns, a slender minaret on a rounded northwest buttress, and four projecting portal treatments. The north entry has broad original vegetal/rosette relief; the west entry has a geometric band; the hospital entry has a tall nested pointed recess, small lower doorway and upper divided window. Removed two floating roof strips after the initial renders and strengthened the broad north relief. Fine carving, calligraphy, exact roof partitions and unseen faces remain abstractions or estimates.

Detail changes remain visible in deliberately close matched views. Context buildings are synthetic continental fixtures; physical laptop/phone measurements remain pending.
